elderReports.author: Datu Makusog
elderReports.transcript: The river has overflowed at the old bridge. Do not attempt to cross. Move immediately to the upland evacuation center!

elderReports.author: Bae Inay
elderReports.transcript: The birds are flying unusually low. A heavy storm is imminent. Gather your livestock now.

communityReports.author: Anonymous
communityReports.transcript: We need drinking water here, the pipes are broken near the chapel.

communityReports.author: Juan Dela Cruz
communityReports.transcript: Trees fell down near the basketball court, road is blocked. Please send clearing operations if possible.

communityReports.author: Maria Santos
communityReports.transcript: We have successfully evacuated 30 families to the high ground shelter. We need more blankets and flashlights.
